verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Replicate serves an llms.txt at replicate.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs index at replicate.com/docs.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The llms.txt content is largely product-overview prose rather than a richly structured doc map. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links comprehensively into the API and reference docs (or an llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://replicate.com/llms.txt # Run AI with an API
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://replicate.com/docs.md Get started
